b.lede: Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra with RTX Spark might not be a gaming laptop first and foremost, but it certainly wants to game. We found that creating a custom 1920x1080-equivalent resolution for its 3:2 screen, missing from its out-of-the-box config, makes for a better experience.
b.title: One easy change makes Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra with RTX Spark a better gaming system
